name: hoc/date-time-picker
description: A higher-order datetime picker component that combines a DateTimePicker input with an integrated calendar and time panel, form-field semantics (label, description, error), locale-aware formatting, optional presets, and a today button. Wraps the DateTimePicker component with full i18n support via ConfigProvider.
useCases: Schedule creation forms requiring exact start date and time with field validation
Booking and reservation systems with date and clock precision and quick-select presets
Analytics dashboard filters comparing datetime ranges with locale-aware display
Workflow automation forms requiring 12h/24h entry with form-field integration
